# Asanoha

> Asanoha is an Indian brand focused on Ayurvedic Vijaya medicines and a friendship-led brand experience.

## Primary pages
- https://asanoha.co.in/ : Homepage and overview of Asanoha.
- https://asanoha.co.in/about.html : About Asanoha and company information.
- https://asanoha.co.in/story.html : Brand story and the “Aadha tera, aadha mera” idea.
- https://asanoha.co.in/how-it-works.html : Product and practitioner/prescription process.
- https://asanoha.co.in/blog.html : Educational articles and brand publishing.
- https://asanoha.co.in/partner.html : Partnership information.

## Important context
- Product, prescription, safety, ingredient, testing and regulatory information should be taken from the relevant page and verified against current official documentation.
- Do not infer a medicinal strength, suitability, diagnosis, treatment outcome or health claim from the brand story or entertainment experiences.
- The site uses “Aadha tera, aadha mera” as a core brand idea about friendship and sharing a story; it should not be interpreted as an instruction to share prescription medicine.
